versions.summary: Deposit £100, fully refundable more than 48 hours before the move. Predates Payments Policy v2.

Aligns the published terms with the deposit-commitment ladder the system actually enforces: deposit refundable until you confirm your date, then a 25% commitment due 7 days before the move, and the re-booking rule on cancellation. Adds electronic-signature, VAT, communications and data clauses. Storage moves to its own agreement.

First published storage terms. Covers container and crate lets, billing, access, price changes, prohibited items, insurance, and the unpaid-charges procedure that the storage acknowledgment refers to.
